emma li: Quick update — SummitCare renewed Dedicated for another 12 months and asked to extend their pilot to include our latest KV cache improvements. :tada:

jonah parks: Fantastic. Renewed with a small upsell for burst capacity during peak hours. I'll share the amended SOW in the deal folder.

mayra (revops): Got the renewal signed. Updated billing to monthly committed reserved. Revenue ops note: revenue recognized starting next billing cycle.

tess (marketing): Nice! Can we get a short customer quote once the pilot extension shows perf improvements? I'll draft a one-pager.

emma li: Yes — SummitCare product lead is open to a short quote after week 3.

oliver (legal): I attached the amendment (SLA tweaks + addendum for KV cache persistence): https://redwood.internal/summitcare/amendment. All countersigned.

deploy-bot: [integration] 1900001000 — kickoff-extension-invite.ics posted to thread.

jonah parks: Action items: 1) SE to run perf with KV cache toggles (jonah) 2) Marketing one-pager + quote ask (tess) 3) Finance updated billing (mayra) 4) Legal amendment uploaded (oliver).

emma li: Thanks team — big win for Dedicated renewals and feature-led upsells. :rocket:
